ops.text: The access and use rights granted to the Company under this Section 1.4 extend to the Company's affiliates and to contractors acting on the Company's behalf, are transferable to any successor to the Company's business (including in a merger or acquisition), are perpetual and irrevocable to the extent paid-up, and may otherwise be terminated only for the Company's uncured material breach.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We appended one sentence to Section 1.4 extending the access and use rights to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, confirming transfer to a successor, and limiting termination of the ongoing rights to our uncured material breach (paid-up rights being perpetual and irrevocable). This is our preferred licence-scope position; existing Section 1.4 text is untouched.
proposal.summary: Append one sentence to Section 1.4 extending the access and use rights to the Company's affiliates and contractors, making them transferable to a successor, perpetual and irrevocable when paid-up, and terminable only for the Company's uncured material breach.

mappings.element: Licence extended to contractors acting on Customer's behalf.
Subscription licences terminable only for uncured material breach.
